GAME.TITLE: general_info
GAME.INFO: The DreamboxXx was made as a site specific arcade for The Dreamhouse/Spectrum community in collaboration with Death By Audio Arcade. All of the games were created as queer games by queer programmers from New York City. The Spectrum started in 2011 as an LGBTQIA creative space/ dance studio and venue. The second space, The Dreamhouse was started in 2016 continuing to provide creative space as well as a venue for performance, live music, and nightlife. To find our more email TheSpectrum6@gmail.com

GAME.INFO: FROGS DOING THE WAVE. that's it that's the game. Programming: Dexter Gramfors. Knitting and hardware: Wesna

GAME.TITLE: SPECIAL DE.LEVER.Y
GAME.INFO: Deliver as many packages as you can to their destinations within the time limit. Use the levers to control engine power. Packages will automatically attach to the bottom of your drone, and can be released using the button. The button can also be used to flip your drone if you find yourself stuck upside-down.

GAME.TITLE: Trashbot
GAME.INFO: You're trashbot. You bus tables. You're overworked and never get a break. Make score go up to satisfy your fitness function.

GAME.TITLE: Dream Hard
GAME.CREDITS: game by Robert Yang, music by Renim
GAME.INFO: A queer brawler defense game. Defend the Dreamhouse from thinly-veiled white supremacists, and look great while doing it.
